summary: Implemented the terminal window title control in the rich repository. Changes: SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 added to ControlType in rich/segment.py, with Tuple[ControlType, str] added to the ControlCode union; formatting entry and Control.title classmethod in rich/control.py emitting OSC 0 (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL); Console.set_window_title in rich/console.py, gated only on is_terminal, returning True/False; a set-title branch in rich/_windows_renderer.py calling term.set_title; an Added entry under Unreleased in CHANGELOG.md linking PR 2200; and tests in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Per instructions, tests were not run, no code was executed, and nothing was committed. Verification was by reading only. Black formatting was not run either.
